title: SEC7: app.js line 419 — innerHTML violates textContent pattern
description: renderChatList() line 419 uses 'ul.innerHTML = ''' to clear the chat list, violating the pattern used everywhere else in the codebase (textContent = ''). This is a consistency violation that could mislead future maintainers into using innerHTML elsewhere. While this particular operation is safe (clearing a container), it's inconsistent with the defensive XSS posture. Should be 'ul.textContent = '''
